tokens.name: color-background
tokens.usage: Page ground behind every screen. The default ground every text token is checked against.

tokens.name: color-surface
tokens.usage: Raised rows and panels: Waymark pin rows, toasts, confirm bars, undo bar. In dark it sits within 1.1:1 of the background, so a surface needs a hairline or a gap to read as separate.

tokens.name: color-text
tokens.usage: Body copy, titles, values. 8.9:1 on background and 8.0:1 on surface in dark; 7.0:1 and 9.9:1 in light.

tokens.name: color-text-muted
tokens.usage: Second step of text: labels, meta lines, notes, eyebrows. Retrace and Waymark's --color-text-muted, as a flat alpha. Dark 5.8:1 / 5.3:1, light 5.4:1 / 7.1:1 on background / surface.

tokens.name: color-text-faint
tokens.usage: Third step of text: chart ticks, axis names, legend labels. Raised in dark from 65% (4.4:1 on surface) to 70% (4.9:1). Light 4.7:1 / 6.0:1. Never fainter: below these the text fails 4.5:1.

tokens.name: color-hairline
tokens.usage: Separators between ledger and list rows (Retrace's 10% rule). Decorative only: it carries no meaning, so it is not held to 3:1.

tokens.name: color-primary
tokens.usage: The brand ink: the app marks, the primary series in charts (planned). Dark's gold, light's blue. As text in light it fails (2.1:1): use color-primary-text.

tokens.name: color-primary-text
tokens.usage: Primary used as text: hero stat values, links, text buttons, chip hover label. 6.4:1 / 5.8:1 dark, 5.4:1 / 7.6:1 light.

tokens.name: color-secondary
tokens.usage: Second series: the contour lines. Dark's sage, light's orange: the hue flips between themes, so never let it mean ahead or behind (see color-ahead).

tokens.name: color-secondary-text
tokens.usage: Secondary as text: Waymark's file count, Unsaved changes tag, warnings. 6.4:1 / 5.8:1 dark, 5.1:1 / 7.3:1 light.

tokens.name: color-accent
tokens.usage: The live and alert hue: Terminus's position marker and live dot, deviation strips. As a mark on the ground it reads 2.5:1 in dark and 2.8:1 in light; for meaning use color-behind, for text color-accent-text.

tokens.name: color-accent-text
tokens.usage: Accent as text: errors, cutoff over, destructive buttons, flagged weather. Dark raised from #f2789d (4.2:1 on surface) to #f382a4 (5.0:1 / 4.5:1). Light 4.9:1 / 6.9:1.

tokens.name: color-success
tokens.usage: Toast success edge and the ok tier's mark. Light's green is 1.9:1 on the background: a fill or edge only, never text.

tokens.name: color-success-text
tokens.usage: Success as text (ok badge, Saved). Light reuses Retrace's ahead text (30% success in text, 4.8:1 / 6.8:1). Dark 5.4:1 / 4.9:1.

tokens.name: color-progress
tokens.usage: Terminus's progress fill on the route. Not used as text.

tokens.name: color-behind
tokens.usage: Behind the plan, or over a cutoff, as a mark: gap areas, dumbbell dots, strips. Raised from the accent (2.5:1 dark, 2.8:1 light) to 3.3:1 / 3.0:1 dark and 3.0:1 / 4.3:1 light. Same hue as accent, so behind and live share a red.

tokens.name: color-behind-text
tokens.usage: Behind the plan as text: readout values, row values with data-tone=behind.

tokens.name: color-ahead
tokens.usage: Ahead of the plan as a mark. Dark is the sage secondary (3.5:1 / 3.1:1). Light is the success green, darkened from #16a34a (1.9:1) to #117c38 (3.0:1 / 4.3:1); light's secondary is orange and beside the red would read as a second shade of bad.

tokens.name: color-ahead-text
tokens.usage: Ahead of the plan as text. Light is Retrace's color-mix of 30% success into text, resolved to hex.

tokens.name: color-direction-up
tokens.usage: Uphill in the terrain bar and its legend dot: color-text at 85%. Direction is neutral so it never borrows the brand gold or the ahead sage. Dark 6.9:1 / 6.3:1, light 5.1:1 / 6.5:1 on background / surface. Replaces color-uphill.

tokens.name: color-direction-flat
tokens.usage: Flat in the terrain bar: color-text at 30%. Under 3:1 on purpose (dark 2.2:1 / 2.1:1, light 1.6:1 / 1.7:1): it is the quiet middle, set apart from its neighbours by a 2px ground-coloured gap and named with its percentage in the legend.

tokens.name: color-direction-down
tokens.usage: Downhill in the terrain bar and its legend dot: color-text at 55%. Dark 3.9:1 / 3.6:1; light 2.6:1 / 3.0:1, under 3:1 on the background, so the gap and the label carry it there. Replaces color-downhill.

tokens.name: color-effort-1
tokens.usage: Terrain hue, palest step on dark (deepest-but-one on light). Dusty mauve, hue 288, 30% saturation: the one hue for terrain, never for status, plan or direction. Difficulty: slope 0-5%, runnable, descents in the effort chart. Dark 3.4:1 / 3.1:1, light 3.0:1 / 4.3:1 on background / surface.

tokens.name: color-effort-2
tokens.usage: Terrain difficulty, step 2: slope 5-10%. Dark 4.3:1 / 3.9:1, light 4.2:1 / 6.0:1.

tokens.name: color-effort-3
tokens.usage: Terrain difficulty, step 3: slope 10-15%, marginal. Dark 5.6:1 / 5.0:1, light 5.8:1 / 8.3:1. The first step that holds 4.5:1, so the lightest one allowed as text (descent label).

tokens.name: color-effort-4
tokens.usage: Terrain hue, step 4. Difficulty: slope 15-20%, climbs in the effort chart and their label. Dark 7.2:1 / 6.5:1, light 7.9:1 / 11.1:1.

tokens.name: color-effort-5
tokens.usage: Terrain difficulty, hardest step: slope 20%+, hike-only. Dark 9.2:1 / 8.3:1, light 10.0:1 / 14.1:1. Each step is about 1.3x the contrast of the one before, so neighbours stay apart.

tokens.name: color-profile-day
tokens.usage: Daylight under the elevation profile, and its legend dot: the terrain mauve, the paler shade in both themes. Dark is color-effort-4 at 70% (4.4:1 / 4.1:1 on background / surface); light is color-effort-1 at 35% (1.4:1 / 1.6:1: an area bounded by the profile line, read against night). 2.2:1 against color-profile-night in both themes.

tokens.name: color-profile-night
tokens.usage: Night under the elevation profile, and its legend dot: the deeper mauve in both themes. Dark is color-effort-1 at 55% (2.0:1 / 1.9:1, bounded by the profile line); light is color-effort-4 at 60% (3.2:1 / 3.6:1). 2.2:1 against color-profile-day in both themes.

tokens.name: color-control-border
tokens.usage: Outline of every chip, icon button, segmented switch and dot-nav label: a quiet frame, not a signal. Text at 30% dark, 40% light: 2.2:1 / 1.9:1 dark, 2.0:1 / 2.8:1 light (background / surface). Below 3:1 on purpose: each of these controls is named by its text or icon, so WCAG 1.4.11 does not need the outline. Fields keep color-field-border at 3:1, because an empty input is identified by its edge.

tokens.name: color-field
tokens.usage: Input, select and textarea fill (Waymark). Lighter than the cards in light, darker than the ground in dark, so a field reads as editable.

tokens.name: color-field-border
tokens.usage: Field outline. Light raised from #8a8789 (2.0:1 on background, 2.9:1 on surface) to #6e6b6d. Dark 3.6:1 / 3.3:1, 4.4:1 on its own fill.

tokens.name: color-focus
tokens.usage: The 2px focus ring, offset 2px. Light moved from the primary blue (2.1:1 on background) to its text blue (5.4:1). Dark gold 6.4:1.

tokens.name: color-button-primary
tokens.usage: Fill of the one main action on a screen (Waymark's Export, Open on the empty page).

tokens.name: color-on-button-primary
tokens.usage: Label on color-button-primary: 6.4:1 dark, 9.3:1 light.

tokens.name: map-route
tokens.usage: The race route on the map, 4px on a 7px map-casing: the brand gold in both themes, since the outdoors basemap stays light in dark mode. About 1.7:1 on the basemap's land and 1.4:1 on its woods (approximate basemap colours): under 3:1, it relies on its width and the white casing. Chosen on the real map over ink and deep blue, which read too heavy.

tokens.name: map-casing
tokens.usage: The 7px casing under the route, the chevrons along it, the halo of the km labels, the ring and number of every pin.

tokens.name: map-pin
tokens.usage: Checkpoint and waypoint pins, number in white (4.9:1). About 4.3:1 on land, 3.6:1 on woods. On the map the accent means a pin, not live or behind.

tokens.name: map-live
tokens.usage: The picked or live thing on the map: the selected pin (Waymark), the runner's position (Terminus), off-route track (Retrace). The light theme's color-effort-1 mauve, about 4.6:1 on land, 3.9:1 on woods; on the map it does not mean terrain.

tokens.name: map-label
tokens.usage: Km labels along the route, haloed in map-casing.

tokens.name: map-shadow
tokens.usage: The drop shadow that lifts a pin or marker off the basemap: 0 1px 2px for pins, 0 1px 3px for round markers. The only shadow on the map.

styles.name: hero-name
styles.usage: The race name on a story's first screen. clamp(2.75rem, 11vw, 7rem): 44px on a phone, 112px wide. max 20ch.

styles.name: section-title
styles.usage: A story section's title. clamp(2.25rem, 6vw, 3.5rem): 36px to 56px.

styles.name: stat-value
styles.usage: Hero and Right now numbers. clamp(1.75rem, 4vw, 2.5rem). In color-primary-text (hero) or color-text.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The app name beside its mark, level with the 44px theme toggle. First half in color-text-muted.

styles.name: eta
styles.usage: Checkpoint arrival time, the hero clock.

styles.name: stat-label
styles.usage: Under a hero stat. Uppercase. color-text-muted.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Section label above a title, ledger row label. Uppercase. color-text-muted.

styles.name: data-label
styles.usage: Label in a checkpoint stats grid, readout, file name. The floor for data text.

styles.name: footer
styles.usage: Footer and build number (0.6875rem). The smallest size any app sets outside the 9 and 10px chart labels.

styles.name: chart-label
styles.usage: --font-size-xsmall: plot labels, legends, rows lists, rs-stat-label. Below the 11px floor: kept exact, flagged.

styles.name: chart-tick
styles.usage: --font-size-xxsmall: axis names, tick labels, strip readouts. Below the 11px floor: kept exact, flagged.

styles.name: body-small
styles.sample: Click the route on the map, or add a pin at a distance below.
styles.usage: Notes, toasts, confirm bars, field values.

styles.name: checkpoint-name
styles.usage: A checkpoint's name in a row.

fontSize.note: Theme.js's raw scale, read as JS values by every *.style.js. Outdoor mode multiplies each by 1.35 and lifts medium weight to 500.

tokens.name: font-size-xxsmall
tokens.usage: Tick and axis labels. Below the 11px floor.

tokens.name: font-size-xsmall
tokens.usage: Chart labels, legends. Below the 11px floor.

tokens.name: font-size-tiny
tokens.usage: Eyebrows, data labels, file name, meta.

tokens.name: font-size-small
tokens.usage: Controls, notes, stat labels.

tokens.name: font-size
tokens.usage: Body.

tokens.name: font-size-medium
tokens.usage: ETA, clock, lede.

tokens.name: font-size-large
tokens.usage: Route stats values.

tokens.name: font-size-xlarge
tokens.usage: Wordmark.

tokens.name: font-size-xxlarge
tokens.usage: Defined, unused by the three apps today.

fontWeight.note: Theme.js names are one step off CSS: bold is 600, semibold 500, medium 400.

tokens.name: font-weight-bold
tokens.usage: Titles, values, controls, eyebrows.

tokens.name: font-weight-semibold
tokens.usage: Details toggle; medium's value in outdoor mode.

tokens.name: font-weight-medium
tokens.usage: Body, field values, secondary values.

tokens.name: font-weight-thin
tokens.usage: Defined, rarely used.

tokens.name: font-weight-light
tokens.usage: Defined, rarely used.

spacing.note: Theme.js spacing array, indexed spacing[0..8] in px. Section padding is fluid: clamp(4rem, 14vh, 7rem) block, clamp(1.25rem, 6vw, 4rem) inline.

tokens.name: space-0
tokens.usage: spacing[0].

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: spacing[1]: hairline offsets.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: spacing[2]: label to value.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: spacing[3]: legend gaps, dot size.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: spacing[4]: stat row gap, toast padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: spacing[5]: between stat row and chart.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: spacing[6]: section block padding floor (4rem).

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: spacing[7].

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: spacing[8].

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Max width of a story section's inner column and of every app's start page, centred.

tokens.name: touch-target
tokens.usage: Minimum height and width of every control.

tokens.name: border-radius-xs
tokens.usage: Focus ring corner, legend swatches, row highlight.

tokens.name: border-radius-sm
tokens.usage: Fields, pin rows, confirm bars, Unsaved tag, terrain bar.

tokens.name: border-radius-md
tokens.usage: Toasts, checkpoint stats grid, lazy panel placeholder.

tokens.name: border-radius-base
tokens.usage: Chips, segmented switch, dot nav callout, collapse toggle.

tokens.name: border-radius-lg
tokens.usage: Status badges (pill).

tokens.name: border-radius-xl
tokens.usage: Defined, unused by the three apps today.

tokens.name: border-radius-full
tokens.usage: Icon buttons, dots, spinners.

breakpoint.note: Theme.js breakpoints; the apps also use 23.5em, 28em and 50em in single components.

tokens.name: breakpoint-sm
tokens.usage: 640px: ledger and row labels go above their row.

tokens.name: breakpoint-md
tokens.usage: 832px: Waymark's toolbar splits onto two lines.

tokens.name: breakpoint-lg
tokens.usage: 1024px: wide layout.

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: Side padding of every reading page: the start pages, the story sections, Retrace's setup. 20px on a phone, 64px wide.

tokens.name: gutter-tool
tokens.usage: Side padding of a working screen with a map or a toolbar: Waymark's editor, Regimen's toolbar. Tighter than gutter so the map keeps its width.

tokens.name: z-index-overlay
tokens.usage: Theme toggle, dot nav.

tokens.name: z-index-modal
tokens.usage: Modals. Terminus's toasts sit at 10500, above its full-screen blockers.
